title: fix: org client timeouts, account upsert tags, budget action scp refs (proven via downstream pnpm patch)
description:
## .what

three defects in declastruct-aws@1.13.0 (also present in 1.13.1), each proven live against a real org
and held downstream as a pnpm patch until a release ships them. the patch:
ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-nheuron `patches/declastruct-aws@1.13.0.patch` (branch vlad/collect-from-gmail).

follows #136 (defects 3 + 4 there are this issue's §3 and the extant sso crash).

## 1. organizations clients carry no request timeout → a plan can hang forever

**symptom**: a plan of an scp wish hangs at random on a policy read. a trace showed one
`ListPolicies` page with no `NextToken` — not a token loop. the socket simply stalled.

**cause**: every organization-family client is built bare —
`new OrganizationsClient({ region: context.aws.credentials.region })` — so no request timeout
and no adaptive retry apply. `dist/access/sdks/getAwsClientConfig.js` already holds the right
config (adaptive retry, maxAttempts 8, requestTimeout 120000, connectionTimeout 8000), but the
organizations and sso-admin clients do not use it.

**fix**: build each with `getAwsClientConfig({ region })` — `getAwsOrganizationsClient` plus the
15 inline constructors under `domain.operations/organization*/`. sso-admin wants the same.

**proof**: after the patch, accounts / sso / budget wishes plan to completion on every run.

## 2. `setOrganizationAccount` upsert never writes the declared tags → endless UPDATE

**symptom**: an account made outside declastruct (console) plans `UPDATE tags: undefined → {…}`
forever; apply reports success, re-plan shows the same UPDATE.

**cause**: on upsert of an extant account, the set returns `foundBefore` unchanged unless
`SYNC_WRITEONLY_TAGS=DeclaredAwsOrganizationAccount`; even then it writes only the
`_decla_writeonly_*` tags, never `desired.tags`.

**fix**: on upsert, always `TagResourceCommand` with `desired.tags`; keep the write-only backfill
behind its env gate (aws never returns those create-time values, so assert them only on opt-in).

**proof**: plan `UPDATE` ×2 → apply `applied: 2` → re-plan `KEEP` ×3.

## 3. budget action scp refs come back by primary → endless UPDATE

**symptom**: a wish that declares an `APPLY_SCP_POLICY` action with
`policy: RefByUnique({ name })` and `target: RefByUnique({ email })` (the only keys knowable
before create) plans UPDATE forever: remote `RefByPrimary({ id })` vs desired `RefByUnique`.

**cause**: `castIntoDeclaredAwsBudgetAction` casts `PolicyId` / `TargetIds[0]` to primary refs
(its own note names the asymmetry). `executionRole` already casts back by unique; these two do not.

**fix**: in `getOneBudgetAction`, look up the policy and the target account by primary and
re-express both refs by unique (`name`, `email`); keep the primary ref when the lookup finds none.

**proof**: budget wish plan `KEEP` ×9 + `UPDATE` ×2 → with the patch, `KEEP` ×11, no apply needed.

## .ask

ship all three upstream (source, not dist), with a clamp per defect, so the downstream patch can drop.
